name: map-reduce-review
description: Split a list into three parts, review each part at once, then reduce the reviews to one summary. The fan-out is fixed: each mapper takes its own share of the same input.

nodes.instruction: Your input is a list of items (lines). Number them and answer with the numbered list only.
Take the first third of the numbered items in your input (rounding up). For each, give a one-line assessment.
Take the second third of the numbered items in your input. For each, give a one-line assessment.
Take the last third of the numbered items in your input. For each, give a one-line assessment.
Your input is three sets of assessments. Merge them into one list in item order, then give the three most important findings.
